::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Architecture

The annual route has three invariant controllers:

```text
Step 1 approved sources + analyst-owned year files
  -> five-file private candidate
Step 2 human review and approval
  -> manifested five-file public_ready payload
Step 3 approval and checksum verification
  -> authoritative public files + website mirrors
```

Routine annual content belongs in the year-specific files, not in the controllers:

```text
scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_interpretation.do
scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_focus.do
scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_toc.csv
```

The interpretation file supplies reviewed narrative and the three concise key messages used in the public health update. The Focus file composes the year-specific Special chapter. Create these from the maintained pattern and review their sources before Step 1.

## Step 1: build the candidate

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do`

Menu: **User > BNR > Annual CVD report > Step 1: Build annual report candidate**

```stata
do "scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do" ///
    REPORT_YEAR EVENT_YEAR EVENT_MONTH MORTALITY_YEAR MORTALITY_MONTH ///
    REPORT_VERSION [replace]
```

The controller requires release-stamped event and mortality CSVs in both `$BNR_PUBLIC` and the website mirror, then checks each pair by size and checksum. It also requires the year-specific interpretation and Focus files.

The reusable composition is `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_standard.do`. Stata `putpdf` creates the report body and appends the one-page public health update from `templates/bnr_report_annual_public_health_update.do`. `scripts/python/stamp_annual_report_pdf.py` performs presentation-only PDF finishing: page furniture, a linked two-level contents page and extraction/stamping of the final update page. The Python helper does not read data or alter analytical content.

Step 1 writes:

```text
$BNR_STAGING/reports/cvd/annual/bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN/candidate/
  bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN.pdf
  bnr_cvd_public_health_update_YYYY_vN.pdf
  index.qmd
  public_health_update.qmd
  report.yml
```

`report.yml` records the report IDs, version, source release IDs and fingerprints, output names and build time. The private log is under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.

Review all five files. Check the full PDF, contents links, Special chapter, methods material and the final update page. Check the separate update is exactly one page and has the same analytical content as the final page. Preview both QMDs and verify public PDF links.

`replace` may rebuild an unapproved candidate deliberately. If `approval.yml` already exists for that version, Step 1 stops; create a higher version.

## Step 2: approve the candidate

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do`

Menu: **Step 2: Approve annual report candidate**

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do" ///
    REPORT_YEAR REPORT_VERSION "Full Name" "BNR Analyst" ///
    candidate disclosure ready
```

Only an authorised **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** may approve. All three literal confirmations are required. The wrapper calls `bnr_report_approve_candidate.do`, which validates candidate identity and version, copies the exact five files into `public_ready`, fingerprints them in `public_manifest.csv`, and writes `approval.yml` last. There is no approval `replace` option.

Check:

```text
$BNR_STAGING/reports/cvd/annual/bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN/public_ready/
  bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN.pdf
  bnr_cvd_public_health_update_YYYY_vN.pdf
  index.qmd
  public_health_update.qmd
  report.yml
  public_manifest.csv
  approval.yml
```

The manifest must contain exactly five payload rows. The approval records candidate, disclosure and readiness confirmation and means approved, not published.

## Step 3: publish the approved report

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do`

Menu: **Step 3: Publish approved annual report**

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do" REPORT_YEAR REPORT_VERSION [replace]
```

The wrapper calls `bnr_report_publish_candidate.do`. It reads only `public_ready`, validates the approval role and identity, verifies the manifest fingerprint and all five payload fingerprints, and copies the exact approved files.

| Product | Authoritative location | Website location |
|---|---|---|
| Full PDF | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY.pdf` | `site/downloads/files/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/` |
| One-page PDF | Same authoritative annual folder | Same website download folder |
| Annual landing page | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/index.qmd` | `site/surveillance/cvd/reports/annual/YYYY/index.qmd` |
| Update landing page | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/public_health_update.qmd` | `site/surveillance/cvd/reports/briefings/YYYY/index.qmd` |
| Shared metadata | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/report.yml` | Website download folder |

The stable public filenames omit the version; `report.yml` retains it. Existing output requires `replace`. The publisher refuses a downgrade; use a higher approved version for a correction. `replace` with the same approved version is reserved for controlled recovery.

After Step 3, run a complete Quarto render, check both landing pages and PDFs, and confirm the annual report and public health update appear correctly in both listings. The private Step 3 log is under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.

Regression coverage is in `scripts/stata/reporting/tests/bnr_report_test_annual_lifecycle.do`.
